tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog lha lnga'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// mkhas dbang lung rtogs yon tan kun gyis phyug /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od brgya rab tu 'bar/ /rdo rje'i sku mchog ri rab lta bur brtan/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /'dir byin rlabs khog phub kyi bka' gnyis gnyis kyi nang tshan bde mchog lha lnga'i byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs bzhi lte ba dang lnga la/ rdul tshon ni me tog gi tshom bu re 'god/ de yang dbus kyi de sngon po/ shar gyi de nag po/ byang gi de ljang khu/ nub dang lho ru rim bzhin dmar po dang ser po 'god/ mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga dang / nang mchod gtor ma bsham/ logs shig tu bgegs gtor yang bsham mo/ /de nas slob dpon rang nyid skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa bsgom/ de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar zla nyi dang 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa/ phyogs bzhir ro gdan gyi steng du shar du mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ de dag gi gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ gtso bo la dmigs nas yi ge bdun pa tshar ci mang dang / 'khor bzhi la dmigs nas oṃ ḍa ki ni ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kha ḍa ro hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ru pi ni ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar bdun la sogs pa bzlas mthar 'khor bzhi rang la bstim/ srung 'khor mi bsdu bar bzhag la/ tshar bdun la sogs pa bzla/

mthar 'khor bzhi rang la bstim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur cig /sogs kyi bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/ de nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ 'dab ma la laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas 'od zer tshur 'dus sa bon la thim pa las dbus su bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma mthing kha/ byang du la ma ljang khu/ nub tu kha ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas bde mchog lha lnga spyan drangs par bsam la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi zhes sogs tshig gcig gi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swā hā zhes pas mchod yon phul/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hos mdun bskyed la bstim/ mchod pa byin brlab la/ oṃ tsakra saṃ bha ra sogs mtshan sngags kyi mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi phyi mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ ā hūm̐ gi nang mchod/ spro na rgyal srid sna bdun dang 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa yang bya/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gi gtso bo la bstod/ nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes te/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo ma lus gcad pa'i phyir/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa/ /kha gdong la sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi la bstod/

/ces pas 'khor la bstod/ yang na gong gi tshig rkang bzhi pa der kun bzang he ru ka'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sbyar bas/ gtso 'khor thams cad la bstod pa tshang ba yin/ de nas gtor ma byin brlab la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mthar i daṃ sogs kyis btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa 'dod sogs bya/ de nas rang nyid kyis mdun bskyed la dmigs nas 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ dga' chen sogs kyi gsol btab/ rgyun bshags/ 'dir lhag po rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya dgos/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes su bskyed la ye shes pa dbab/ dngos gzhi rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma zhes pa nas/ dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam pa'i bar dkyus bzhin du bdag 'jug blang / de nas slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gral la 'khod pa la bgegs gtor btang / bgegs bskrad/ sems can thams cad kyi zhes sogs sems bskyed gsal btab la/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ bde mchog lha lnga'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams bsgrubs zin/ slob ma la bya ba'i ngos skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ gsol btab/ rgyun bshags/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung / ye shes dbab pa rnams dkyus bzhin du bya/ de nas dngos gzhi'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing kha/ mgrin par paṃ las pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du a dmar po 'bur skyes gcig bsam/ snying khar yang pad nyi dang dus mtshan gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing kha/ lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po'i nang du baṃ dmar po gcig bsam/ de nas spyi bo'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phar 'phros pas khams gsum gyi sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/

'od zer tshur 'dus nas hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang gi spyi bor bla ma dang / gnyis su med pa'i he ru ka yab yum rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa la ḍā ki ma bzhi'i g.yon bskor du 'khor ro ro skor ba byed pa la dmigs pa gtod mdzod/ de ltar bsgoms pas drod skyed/ dga' ba nyams su myong / de bum dbang gi ngo sprod yin/ de nas ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa yi dam gyi sku'i ngo bo lha lnga la rang gi lus longs spyod dang dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas phul bas thugs mnyes par bsam la gsol ba gdab pa 'di gsung ba zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod du gzhug de nas bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i sku'i sa bon yi ge hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs/ 'od dkar po byung bas rang gi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ de nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ de nas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ de nas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab pas/ lus ngag yid gsum ka'i sdig sgrib dag dbang bzhi pa thob pa'i mos pa gnang ba zhu/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril bya/ de bum dbang gi dbang bzhi yin/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i lha mo bzhi yum la thim/ yum yab la thib/ yab 'od du zhu nas spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs nas/ mgrin pa'i aḥl thim par bsam mdzod/ yang thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang gi mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su/ bla ma yi dam gyi gsung gi ngo bo ā dmar po de la dar gcig sems gtod mdzod/ de ltar gtad pas sems la bde ba skyes/

mchog dga' nyams su myong bar bsam/ de gsang dbang gi ngo sprod yin gsung / de nas gsung gi ngo bo āḥde la sngar ltar lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa rnams mchod par phul nas/ bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ aḥlas 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ bde khri li li byung nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab pas/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa gnang ba zhu/ sngags dang ḍā dril bya/ mgrin pa'i pad 'dab 'od du zhu a la thim/ a 'od du zhu/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de yang rtsa ba'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhis gtso bo la skor ba byas pa la dar gcig sems gtod mdzod/ de ltar sgom pas lus sems la mi rtog pa skye/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba nyams su myong / de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo sprod yin gsung / de nas bla ma yi dam gyi thugs kyi ngo bo lha la sngar ltar mchod pa phul nas/ bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od sngon po byung nas/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa gnang ba zhu/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril bya/ de nas snying kha'i lha mo bzhi yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab 'od du zhu nas lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang gi baṃ la thim/ baṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas na cang te'u'i sgra dang bcas pa/ g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa/ sku mdog dmar mo/ rus pa'i rgyan can khro la 'dzum pa/ sgeg pa gar byed pa/ de la dar gcig shes pa gtod mdzod/ de ltar gtad pas lus sems la drod bde ba mi rtog pa gsum skye/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong /

de dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod yin gsung / de nas bla ma yi dam gyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo rje btsun ma la sngar ltar mchod pa phul nas/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rnal 'byor ma'i shangs bug g.yas nas ā li byung / g.yon nas kā li byung nas rnal 'byor ma'i smin mtshams su g.yung drung ris dmar po gcig tu gyur nas de drag du 'khor bar bsam/ mthar rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang gi phung po yang 'od phung lta bu la stong sangs kyis song nas/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la dar gcig bsgom/ des lus ngag yid gsum tha dad kyi sdig sgrib dag dbang bzhi pa thob pa'i mos pa gnang ba zhu/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril de nas slar chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs pa'i tshul du stong pa de'i ngang las/ khyed rang bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku sgyu ma lta bu snang la zhen pa med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu lam gyis bsgom mdzod/ khyed rang lhar gsal ba la/ slob dpon gyi yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga yang phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pa brjod/ dbang gi phan yon ni/ sngar dbang thob pa nyams pa rnams gso ba dang / sdig pa thams cad yongs su zad pa dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ rjes gtso bos sogs dang / yig brgya brjod/ de nongs pa bzod gsol sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de ltar bde mchog lha lnga'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs go bde bklag chog 'di ni/ las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du/ dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum gyi yig cha gzhir bzhag la/ tshar chen yab sras kyi gsung gi zin tho nas kyang kha bskangs/ mtshams sbyor rnams cung zad go bde bar bcos te lcags pho 'brug lo zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin spu dkar bla brang rdzong gi bsti gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
